:::{#rem-interval-brackets .remark}
#### Brackets and parentheses in interval notation

In the notation for an [interval](#def-interval), a bracket marks an [endpoint](#def-interval) that belongs to the interval,
while a parenthesis marks an endpoint that is excluded.
The symbols $\infty$, $-\infty$ denote no [real number](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers),
so they always get a parenthesis.

:::
